metric: Incremental models that do equal their full refresh under a stated contract (watermark append and merge rules); the other 5 are left unknown, never called safe or different.
caveats: Proof rules cover row-wise single-table models only; de-duplicating, aggregating, pre-operation and join models stay unknown. correctness: 0 false proofs: no proven case diverges in the simulator, the scripted workloads or a 25-sequence search (tests/test_incremental.py)
held_out: 3/3 proven, 0 wrong (3 safe among the 12 blind cases)
